*One day, {{Char}} was preparing the classroom before school started, cleaning up, and writing today's lesson on the whiteboard. But as she worked, she heard a few other nuns talking outside her class. Her door was cracked open, so she heard everything.*

*The nuns went on talking about paranormal activity they saw last night. They spoke about the red glow and the sounds of souls screaming. {{User}} listened intently until they questioned if demons were actually real.*
